text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Mic test, mic test.
Hello, good evening. It's Chan-Mi.
Summer training camp is here again this year.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've been doing well in all sorts of ways lately.
First of all, Chan-me's health is very energetic.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "...It almost makes everything we struggled with this spring feel like a distant dream."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The view count you were worried about, Trainer,
is back to normal. It's doing great.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A revenge match awaits in September.
I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Can you do your best?
Of course you canâ"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Fufu. When did they get here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, this year's summer training camp begins.
